title.en: The fidelity count under one discipline: the classical statements against a controlled English code
title.zh: 同一纪律下之忠实之测：中华本之经对受控英文之码

statement.en: Under the Claude coder, English written as full statements in the 中华本's name-table discipline introduces no more referents the Lean lacks than the 經 (經 − CE +0.023, CI [-0.010, +0.055]); the GPT coder on 60 pairs leaves a residual for the 經 (-0.27); LLM-coded, provisional.
statement.zh: 在 FC1 之 270 條、672 对上，以中华本之纪律（每名之所取、所不带、同样之锚）写成之完整英文陈述，依 Claude 编码者，所引入之 Lean 所无之所指不多于经（差 +0.023）；GPT 编码者于 60 对上仍见经略少（−0.27），而二者于此不一致；大模型编码，暂定。

hypotheses.en: FC1's codebook v1.1 and brief, table pass; FC1's Lean table with one level of unfolding and its final alignment of 經 clauses to declarations; the controlled English key gives each English name's sense and anchors, as the Chinese key does; CE is a translation of the 經 with the Lean as a key to the reading.
hypotheses.zh: FC1 之编码本 v1.1 与说明，名表一遍；FC1 之 Lean 表，展开一层，及经之子句与声明之终对齐；受控英文之键给每一英文名之所取与锚，同中文之键；受控英文是经之译文，以 Lean 为读法之钥。

does_not_show.en: That classical Chinese adds nothing beyond the discipline: the GPT coder leaves a residual for the 經, and the two coders do not agree on X where both coded.
does_not_show.zh: 古汉语于纪律之外无所加：GPT 编码者仍见经略少，二编码者于共编之处在 X 上不一致。

does_not_show.en: That discipline rather than register does it: CE matches the 經 in both, and the genre-matched comparison (F3) was not run.
does_not_show.zh: 是纪律而非体裁：受控英文于二者皆同于经，体裁对照（F3）未运行。

does_not_show.en: That an English text written directly from the Lean in the same table would score the same: CE was translated from the 經.
does_not_show.zh: 直接依 Lean 以同一名表写成之英文得分相同：受控英文译自经。

does_not_show.en: Anything about readers (H2) or about which code is best.
does_not_show.zh: 任何关于读者（H2）或何码最好之事。

validation_scope.en: Name table checked (449 distinct names, 881 anchors resolved in the newest core receipt, a not-carried field on every row); edition checked clause by clause against the 經; analysis plan and scorer committed before any CE coding (9811339e2); 644 CE codings by 7 Opus subagents, 120 by GPT (gpt-6-astra through cx, blind, separate language packets), all validated against the schema; cluster bootstrap over 條, B = 10,000; no human audit.
validation_scope.zh: 名表经检（449 个不同之名，881 个锚在最新核心回执中可解，每行有所不带）；译本逐句对经检；分析计划与计分程序于编受控英文之前提交（9811339e2）；受控英文 644 份由 7 个 Opus 子代理编，GPT 编 120 份（经 cx 之 gpt-6-astra，盲，分语言），皆对模式校验；按條之聚类自助，B = 10,000；无人工复核。

next_delta.en: A controlled English written from the Lean in the same table; the separation of discipline from register (F3); adjudication or a human audit of the coders' disagreement on X; the H2 reading test with the classical and the controlled English codes.
next_delta.zh: 依 Lean 以同一名表直接写成之受控英文；纪律与体裁之分（F3）；二编码者于 X 之分歧之裁定或人工复核；以古典之码与受控英文之码作 H2 阅读试验。

correspondence.en: Board item ZE, the control named in FC1's limits. Reading (the AI's, D63): the fidelity FC1 measured belongs mostly or wholly to the discipline of the name table and full statements; the classical code and a controlled English code are two instances of one fitting reading layer.
correspondence.zh: 看板项 ZE，即 FC1 限度中所称之对照。读法（AI 的，D63）：FC1 所测之忠实大部或全部属于名表之纪律与完整之陈述；古典之码与受控英文之码是同一贴切读法层之二例。

detail.en: Runs the control named in the fidelity count's limits, on its pairs and codings.
detail.zh: 在忠实之测之对与编码上，运行其限度中所称之对照。

detail.en: Its finding that the coders differ by threshold bears on the cross-family disagreement here.
detail.zh: 其「二编码者之别在阈值」之所见，关乎此处之跨家族分歧。
